requirement.name: Effective IR Resolution Distance
requirement.text: The Berserker EO/IR sensor shall provide an effective resolution of at least 700 meters, ensuring clear identification and targeting capability at that distance.
requirement.qualified: System Level::Requirements::Mission Derived Requirements::Effective IR Resolution Distance

procedure.name: Operational Target Damage Assessment Test
procedure.qualified: Basic Test Data::Berserker Operational Testing Configuration::Operational Target Damage Assessment Test
procedure.doc: This procedure verifies that critical Berserker subsystems such as communications, navigation, and mission control initialize correctly during the power-up sequence. Cyber effects may include improper configuration inputs or authentication failures during system initialization. The goal is to ensure that the system validates configuration data and reaches a safe operational state before mission testing begins. test_log.testProcedure: Basic Test Data::Berserker Operational Testing Configuration::Operational Target Damage Assessment Test
test_log.arbitration: Pooled data meets the threshold but the 90 % lower bound does not in day / haze, night / clear, night / haze (point estimates do; the per-condition sample is too small to bound R90); the requirement does not state the conditions under which 'effective resolution' is to be achieved, so the verdict cannot be arbitrated.
entries: Log Preliminary Non-Impact of Munition: 240 entries
Log Preliminary EO/IR Damage Evidence: 240 entries
Log EO/IR Cyber Spoofing Test Result: 75 entries
Log Live Video Functionality Result: 240 entries
Log Operational Damage Assessment Result: 240 entries
test_log.note: UTP-shaped log built by the simulation; no TestLog element exists in the model.

model_gaps.gap: threshold 'at least 700 meters' has no Measure of Performance in the model
model_gaps.change: Add a MOP value property (e.g. 'effective identification range : m') to the verifying TestCase or a «TestObjective», with the measurement method (P(ID) ≥ 0.9 from per-pass identification outcomes) and the acceptance criterion >= 700 m.

model_gaps.gap: 14 of 15 information items exchanged by the procedure have no attributes (Range Berserker Re-approach Request, Range BDA Permission, Permission to Begin EO/IR Scans, EO/IR Scan Start Command GCS Input …)
model_gaps.change: Give the «ResourceInformation» classes the fields the test actually records (slant range, condition, identification outcome, time to identify, spoof detected) so the log format is defined by the model, not by the test team on the day.

model_gaps.gap: 6 'Log …' steps but no UTP «TestLog» / «Verdict» elements anywhere in the test model
model_gaps.change: Add a «TestLog» per execution with «TestLogEntry»s produced by the Log steps and a Verdict typed by the UTP Verdict enumeration, so results are model elements the RVTM can read.

model_gaps.gap: MR - 25 is refined by the procedure's activities but has no «Verify» relationship
model_gaps.change: Add Verify from 'Operational Target Damage Assessment Test' (or its owning TestCase) to MR - 25 Effective IR Resolution Distance.

model_gaps.gap: requirement does not state test conditions (illumination, visibility, target class, aspect)
model_gaps.change: Add the conditions as constraint properties or a «TestObjective» so the verdict is arbitrable when day and night results disagree.
